# fct_site_sessions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_site_sessions` · dbt area: `growth`

Fact table of foratravel.com sessions reconstructed from GA4's multi-event structure. Sessions can include multiple page views. Each row is a unique session with information about the user and their device, plus metrics such as conversions, engagement, and view counts. NOTE Google does not track 100% of sessions -- users can opt out of analytics tracking. Sourced from Google Analytics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `session_key` | Unique key assigned to each session using the user_pseudo_id and the session_id. Can be null >> SOURCE - Google Analytics data_tests: - unique |
| `session_id` | Non-unique ID assigned to each session by Google. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `session_at` | Timestamp of when the session started. Used to partition the table. Filter on this column to optimize query cost and performance. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `campaign` | Used for Attribution. The Campaign associated with UTM when the Session began. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `channel_grouping` | Groups the Attribution fields into a Channel (such as 'Paid Social') using logic defined by Google here https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9756891 >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
